summary: Iteration 30 — Inventory & Accounting stack (ingredients with baseUnit g/mL/ea, recipes with kg<->g + L<->mL conversion + auto product cost roll-up, POS auto-deduct on sale, invoice->stock weighted moving average + recipe cascade re-cost, stock-take with shrinkage, Australian BAS/GST report + CSV export) + notification abstraction fallback. Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS (100%) — covers create/update/delete ingredients (validates baseUnit g/mL/ea; rejects 'litre'), DELETE blocks when used in recipe, /ingredients/low-stock filters (stock<=reorderLevel AND reorderLevel>0), PUT /recipes/product/{id} with kg->g (0.018kg=>18g qtyBase) + L->mL (0.25L=>250mL) conversion, computedCost=1.58 = 18*0.06+250*0.002, rejects incompatible g->mL (HTTP 400), product.cost pushed back, POS transaction (2 lattes) auto-deducts -36g coffee + -500mL milk via deduct_recipe_stock, /invoices/{id}/assign-stock with WMA cost update + stock_movements row + cascade re-roll (recipesRolledUp>=1), /stock-takes records variance + totalShrinkageValue<0 on shrinkage, /accounting/bas window mode (monthStart=2026-05-01&monthEnd=2026-06-30) returns g1/oneA/g11/oneB/netGstPayable with 1A=total/11 invariant, /accounting/bas.csv downloads with text/csv + Content-Disposition attachment header, public POST /online/orders + PATCH .../status returns deliveryReceipts with reason='not_configured' (no SendGrid/Twilio keys — graceful fallback, no crash). Frontend: /inventory-accounting page renders with 5 tabs (Ingredients, Recipes, Invoices->Stock, Stock-take, BAS/GST), recipe editor opens on product pick with line editor + save button + ingredient/unit selects, stock-take save shows shrinkage toast, BAS report tile group rendered with FY2026 Q3 (2026-01-01 -> 2026-03-31) period + 8 tiles (G1/1A/G11/1B/Net GST/Sales count/Stock on hand/Stock received).

issues: 8 repeated 404 console errors on every page load — same empty src='' issue carried over from iteration 29 (not introduced by this iteration). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) BAS CSV download was returning 500 due to unicode '->' (U+2192) in Content-Disposition filename which cannot be encoded as latin-1 by Starlette. Fixed in /app/backend/routes/inventory_accounting.py:455 — sanitize the period label to ASCII before building the filename header. Main agent should review the fix and consider applying similar ASCII-sanitization to any other export endpoints (CSV/PDF download responses) that interpolate period labels.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_accounting.py:_quarter_range has dead-code: 'start = date(year - 1, sm, 1) if quarter == "Q2" else date(year - 1, sm, 1)' (both branches identical) and 'start' is then re-assigned on the very next line. Simplify to a single line.

inventory_accounting.py:assign_invoice_to_stock — when prev_stock is 0 and prev_cost is 0, the WMA formula collapses to line_total/qty_base which is correct, but the floor 'else prev_cost' branch is unreachable in practice (covered by the outer if). Minor cleanup.

inventory_accounting.py:bas_report mixes datetime querying for transactions.timestamp (BSON datetime) with ISO-string range for createdAt — works but fragile. Standardize on one timestamp format across the codebase (recommend BSON datetime everywhere) for consistent date-range queries.

transactions.py:create_transaction swallows ALL exceptions from deduct_recipe_stock with bare 'except Exception: pass'. If recipe deduction silently fails (e.g. DB transient error) the POS sale completes but stock isn't deducted with NO log entry. Add at minimum: logger.exception('recipe-deduct-failed product=%s', item.productId).

notifications.py: send_email + send_sms swallow exceptions and return reason=str(e)[:120] but don't surface to the caller distinguishably from 'not_configured'. The caller (notify_order) just collects receipts — there is no retry queue. Consider adding a 'sent_pending' status + dead-letter persistence on failure for production.

inventory_accounting.py:deduct_recipe_stock has no idempotency guard despite the docstring saying 'Idempotency comes from the caller passing the transaction id as ref' — but the current implementation does NOT actually persist a ref or check for duplicates. A re-tried POST /transactions on network failure could double-deduct. Add a stock_movements row with txnId + unique index, or rely on transactions.id uniqueness.

rca of the issue: BAS CSV 500 RCA: Starlette HTTP headers MUST be latin-1 encodable; the BAS report 'period' label was 'FY2026 Q3 (2026-01-01 -> 2026-03-31)' where '->' is U+2192 (RIGHTWARDS ARROW). When this string was placed into the Content-Disposition filename, Starlette's init_headers tried to .encode('latin-1') and raised UnicodeEncodeError leading to a 500. Mitigation: ASCII-sanitize the period string before header interpolation. Reproduction: GET /api/accounting/bas.csv?fy=2026&quarter=Q3 (any quarter — the arrow is added by inventory_accounting.py:_quarter_range building 'FY{fy} {quarter} ({start} -> {end})'). Fixed.
